faq.q: What kind of work do you take on?
faq.a: Product design and interface motion for digital products — mostly startups shaping a first release, and teams rebuilding a core experience. Most engagements combine product design, motion and a design system.

faq.q: How do you work with clients?
faq.a: Remotely from Berlin, in focused blocks. A typical project runs six to ten weeks: a week of research and scoping, then design sprints with weekly reviews, ending with a handover of files, motion specs and a system your team can extend.

faq.q: Do you work with development teams?
faq.a: Yes. I design in production terms — real components, real states, real motion specs — and stay involved through build so what ships matches what was designed. I can also implement front-end work myself.
Every project is quoted as a fixed fee based on scope, so there are no hourly surprises. Retainers are available when product work is ongoing.
Usually within two to four weeks. Send a short brief through the form below and you’ll get a reply within a day with availability and next steps.
